items.heading: "Devops Salary in India"
items.text: "DevOps salary in India" is close to a meaningless single number, because the gap between an IT-services fresher and a product-company or GCC senior engineer is enormous, and most course-marketing pages quote only the flattering end of it.

rows: The realistic floor for a fresher with no home-lab proof, mostly service-desk-adjacent and support-heavy DevOps-in-name roles at large IT-services firms.
Needs a real portfolio, a hand-built CI/CD pipeline, Terraform-provisioned infrastructure, a working Kubernetes deployment, not certificates alone.
Fresher, unicorn or strong GCC bench, 0-1 year
The exception, not the median. Reserved for candidates who combine a real project with a company that runs serious cloud-native infrastructure in-house.
Progresses slower than product-side pay because most IT-services DevOps work stays close to ticket-driven operations rather than infrastructure ownership.

visuals.heading: Devops Engineer

items.heading: Devops Engineer
items.text: DevOps engineer: owns the delivery lifecycle end to end, builds pipelines, automates deployments, and removes friction between a developer writing code and that code running safely in production. Success is measured by delivery speed and deployment frequency.

items.heading: Platform Engineer
items.text: Platform engineer: builds the internal tooling and self-service platform other engineers use to ship without needing DevOps hand-holding for every deploy. The fastest-growing DevOps-adjacent title in Indian product and GCC hiring right now, and usually a specialisation you grow into, not a fresher entry point.
